Event|7014|LOG_INFO|AMM|IF_03|VSX 3 state local down, remote down
Event|1321|LOG_INFO|AMM|IF_03|LAG 3 State change for IF_33: Actor state: ALFO, Partner state ASFNCD
comp_details.recommended_action: Check the physical layer components, such as cables, connectors, and network interface cards (NICs), for any signs of damage or malfunction. Ensure that all connections are secure and that the NICs are properly configured and functioning. If necessary, replace any faulty components to restore connectivity.

ground_truth.root_cause_entity: Interface 1/1/3 (m1s1p3) - VSX ISL member of LAG3 on switch PSCSCTLEAFB03
ground_truth.root_cause_type: Intermittent physical link flap on VSX inter-switch link (LAG3), causing MC-LAG/VSX state-machine instability and LACP partner desync (recurred at 11:53:13 and 11:59:20)
ground_truth.recommended_action: Inspect and reseat/replace the transceiver and cable on interface 1/1/3; check optical/RS-FEC error counters and CRC/error stats on the port; verify the peer-side port for matching symptoms; if flapping persists, fail over the ISL to a spare link and open a hardware RMA for the SFP/port. Also consider provisioning a redundant VSX ISL member so a single-link flap cannot destabilize the keepalive.
